scenes.stage_direction: The household's polished public account meets the records retained by its workers. Amara speaks for herself.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Nothing. They repeated an account supplied to them.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: A stranger wrote a page, and another stranger carried my child away.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: There is also a message promising discretion to the household.

metadata.evidence_summary: The assessment was manufactured from supplied allegations.
